title: aster candollei
intro: Aster candollei, commonly known as the Chinese autumn gentian, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, offering potential health benefits such as improved cardiovascular health and immune system function. The therapeutic actions of Aster candollei include inhibiting the growth of pathogens, which contributes to its antimicrobial properties, and its anti-tumor properties, which may aid in the prevention of cancer. Bioactive constituents found in Aster candollei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
